item.title: MicroPython vs CircuitPython vs Toit in 2026: Which Embedded Python Runtime Should You Actually Flash?
item.description: You buy a $6 ESP32, plug it in, and discover that “just use Python” hides three completely different products: a firmware that speaks Python over a serial REPL, a firmware that mounts as a USB drive so you can edit code.py in any text editor, and a compiled language with a virtual machine that pushes new code over WiFi in under two seconds.
